_meta.usage: Rivalry logos are for display on frontporchsports.com only. They must never be used on FrontPorchSports.shop merchandise or any other product. Most are non-free (fair use) marks; see each entry's license.
_meta.source: Extracted from the RIVALRIES literal previously inlined in index.html and compare.html; extended 2026-10 from Wikipedia 'List of NCAA college football rivalry games' and each rivalry article (MediaWiki API).
_meta.keyFormat: The two canonical team names, alphabetically sorted, joined by '|'. Lookups must accent-fold: the Fresno St. key uses the un-accented 'San Jose St.' spelling.
_meta.fields: name (display), also_known_as, team1/team2 (dataset names), trophy, logo (path or null), wikipedia_url, wikimedia_file_url, license (as listed on the file page), sponsor_branded, sponsor, status (active = met 2024 or later), last_meeting, logo_light (true = mostly white/light, rendered on a gray backing circle).
